title: Track guide Summit Point Raceway Formula Vee iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake really hard, trail brake to apex
corners.line: use the repaved part of the track

corners.label: T3
corners.line: turn in at leaves on tree, apex middle of corner
corners.mistakes: don't touch inside curb, be smooth

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: tree on right, hard braking, trail brake into corner
corners.line: use repaved part, curb and repave meet at apex

corners.label: T9
corners.line: turn-in at dirt by left wheel, apex middle

general_tips: use left side of track for braking marker at turn one
use all of the track, outside curb out, full throttle to turn five, open turn four up
keep in mind people can draft nearly up past you before the finish line
